fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Days of Wonder’s official archived catalog https://www.daysofwonder.com/other-games/ displays this 2010 Mystery Express box beside the publisher’s English rules link. The image is served from Asmodee’s Days of Wonder media library. Reduced to 360 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The most recent person to board a real train starts and takes the miniature whistle. Play goes clockwise.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: After each round of players' turns, the person who acted last takes the whistle and starts the next round.
